note: List prices in USD per one million tokens. Cost is DERIVED, not metered billing: each model's tokens are priced at its own rate and the per-model spends are summed. Models with a componentRates entry are priced per component (fresh input / output / cache write / cache read); anything else uses one blended input-plus-output rate with no cache discount. A model with no exact entry resolves by normalized id (provider prefix, trailing date, and @quantization stripped), then by family (opus / sonnet / haiku / fable, gpt-5, grok, gemini flash/pro, codestral); self-hosted local models (lmstudio/, ollama/) and deepseek cost 0. The family keys below double as the fallback rate for unseen variants. Component rates below were verified against each vendor's published pricing page on the asOf date; blended rates remain estimates.

componentRates.note: Per-component list rates (USD per 1M tokens), verified against the vendor's published pricing on the asOf date. cacheWrite defaults to 1.25x input (the 5-minute-TTL premium) and cacheRead to 0.1x input when omitted. Claude entries carry an explicit cacheWrite at the 1-hour-TTL 2x rate because Claude Code writes its cache with the 1-hour TTL. Sources: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing; developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5; docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.5 and grok-build-0.1. grok-build is the grok-4.5 alias grok-build-latest. claude-sonnet-5 carries the introductory pricing in effect through 2026-08-31.
